_doc: Idle of the full-body pictures (assets/characters/<id>/lobby/full.png on their skeleton, scenes/character/full_body.gd, assets/README.md), shared by every character; a full.json's anims (from art_source/characters/lineup_parts.json) replace or add tracks by bone. Same format as lobby_anims.json: per animation length (s), loop, tracks: bone -> {t: key times, rot: degrees added to the rest rotation (+ clockwise), x / y: px added to the rest position (full.png px, in the parent's space), sx / sy: scale}. Bones: root, hips, chest, head, arm_l_upper / arm_l_fore / hand_l, arm_r_upper / arm_r_fore / hand_r, leg_l_thigh / leg_l_shin / foot_l, leg_r_* (l / r = the left / right of the picture). Keep it small: one picture, the arms in front of the body stretch the pixels under them.
